notes:
Church Recorder 0.3.1

- Pace status and metadata API requests across the library and recorder to prevent large lists exceeding the website request limit.
- Respect HTTP 429 Retry-After cooldowns, including queued checks and the Refresh button.
- Show a website request-limit message instead of a misleading connection/access error.
- Check selected churches first in the library queue. Large lists refresh gradually within the website budget.

Install over your existing app. Settings, selections and recordings remain. Physical-phone verification remains.
